caption_a:
Type O Negative didn't just write a Halloween anthem — they made October 31st a 365-day-a-year religion. Bloody Kisses sealed it. Black No.1 crowned it. And the rest of the world has been playing catch-up ever since.

This Everyday Is Halloween hoodie is the uniform of that religion. Gothic, defiant, and draped in the same darkness that made Type O the soundtrack to every lit jack-o'-lantern and midnight walk through fog.

Make every day October 31st. Link in bio 🎃

etsy_description:
Every day is Halloween when you're wearing this Type O Negative inspired gothic hoodie that channels the eternal midnight energy of Bloody Kisses and the iconic darkness of Black No.1. Designed for the permanent October crowd — those who never take down the decorations because the gothic celebration never ends.

This dark art pullover captures the spirit of Type O Negative's Halloween legacy — the vampiric romance, the theatrical gloom, the self-aware darkness that made them the definitive soundtrack for everyone who feels most alive when the veil is thin. Premium heavyweight construction delivers warmth and durability that lasts season after season.

The gothic design speaks directly to fans who understood that Black No.1 was more than a song — it was an anthem for a lifestyle. Whether it's January or October, this hoodie keeps you locked into that permanent Halloween energy that Type O Negative bottled in Bloody Kisses.

Not for everyone. For the gothic faithful who celebrate Halloween 365 days a year without apology. An ideal gift for goth metal fans, Halloween enthusiasts, and anyone whose wardrobe is 90% black by choice.

Unisex fit. Machine washable. Darker than a jack-o'-lantern's shadow at midnight.
